The file only serves to describe the package and its sources, consistent with standard AUR packaging practices. No obfuscated content, suspicious dependencies, or unexpected behaviors are present.

The optional dependency on perl-build is appropriate, as plenv is a Perl version manager and building Perl versions requires perl-build. This is a normal and expected dependency. Overall, the file adheres to standard packaging hygiene and poses no security risk.
